messages:
incident-bot: PAGING oncall: 3xx p95 and tail latency spike detected across smart-routing pools for text-generation (model-route: redwood/gpt-8k variants). Error budget burn showing sustained >30% above SLO for 18m. Impacting APAC-heavy routes. Auto-mitigation recommended: temporary rate caps + steering.

maya: oncall here, seeing the same in dashboard. grabbing traces, will triage.

maya: quick snapshot from perf:
```
route: /v1/generate
models: [gpt-8k, gpt-8k-quant]
region: apac-sg
p50: 180ms
p95: 1.2s -> baseline 480ms
p99: 2.6s
err_rate: 0.6% (up from 0.1%)
qps: +67% last 20m
```

maya: looks like burst from a few high-throughput orgs + larger-than-usual long-context requests. KV cache miss rate is up for these routes (cache warming lag).

tony: marking impact: ~12% of overall traffic, but 40% of tail-cost due to long sequences. which customers affected? can we get org ids?

meera: from correlation query: top orgs by p95: org-348 (Fireside Labs), org-772 (internal sandbox), org-991 (partner-analytics). org-348 accounts for ~22% of APAC generation qps.

ashleigh: any recent deploys to serving runtime?

ops-bot: recent deploys: 1968120000 - runtime hotfix (kv-cache heuristics) rolled to 20% canary at 1968119800, no full rollout.

maya: that canary might correlate. but spike predates canary rollout. suspect workload change + regional resource pressure.

carlo: recommendation: 1) apply org-level rate caps for the top offenders 2) adjust smart-routing to prefer EU/US for latency-sensitive traffic 3) disable experimental reranker/reorder feature in APAC as it's adding decoder cost. agree? :thinking:

tony: +1. we should be conservative: prefer steering first, then rate caps if tail doesn't improve. avoid global disable unless necessary.

maya: doing step 2 now — bump latency_weight in smart-routing policy for APAC to prioritize latency over cost (latency_weight 0.6 -> 1.0) and reduce cost_priority for quantized variants to avoid noisy preemption. command: 
```
redwoodctl routing set-policy --region apac-sg --policy-json '{"latency_weight":1.0, "cost_weight":0.2, "tiering":{"prefer":"low-latency"}}'
```

maya: applying live. expecting steering to shift ~45% of affected APAC traffic to eu-west/us-central over next 2m as pools rebalance.

(2m later)

maya: steering propagation seen. p95 for APAC decreased from 1.2s to ~760ms. improvement but still above SLO.

carlo: start org-level soft rate caps for org-348 and org-991: set QPS cap to 8 for generate route, with 429 backoff and retry-header. command: 
```
redwoodctl quota update --org org-348 --route /v1/generate --qps 8 --burst 16 --reason "incident mitigation"
redwoodctl quota update --org org-991 --route /v1/generate --qps 6 --burst 12 --reason "incident mitigation"
```

meera: applied for org-991. org-348 shows throttling now but client is retrying aggressively. we're seeing overall queue depth drop.

maya: disabling reranker flag in APAC: 
```
redwoodctl featureflag set --region apac-sg --flag reranker --value false --rollout 100
```

maya: done. that shaved ~120ms p95 on routed requests. combined with steering + caps we are at p95 ~420ms now for APAC. error rate back to 0.12%.

tony: good. please prepare short customer note for org-348 and partner-analytics indicating we applied temporary QPS caps and steering; include ETA for rollback.

ashleigh: support brief: draft message — "We observed elevated tail latency for some generation requests due to regional resource pressure. To reduce impact, we temporarily limited QPS for a small set of heavy workloads and steered latency-sensitive traffic to our EU/US pools. There may be transient 429s; we're monitoring and will notify when caps are lifted." want me to send?

maya: yes please, send now. include contact for immediate escalation to SRE.

ops-bot: pager: oncall rotation changed — maya handing off to tony in 20m.

maya: handoff summary for tony:
- incident started 1968121650 when latency exceeded SLO
- root cause: workload surge + cache misses in APAC pools; canary heuristics may have amplified but not root cause
- mitigations applied: steering latency_weight ->1.0 (apac), disabled reranker in apac, org-level soft QPS caps for org-348/org-991, monitoring for retry storms
- current state: p95 APAC ~420ms, err_rate 0.12%, traffic shifted ~45% to eu/us, throttles active but keeping throughputs workable
- next actions if regresses: increase QPS caps conservatively, spin up extra apac capacity via dedicated lane (if available), escalate to infra to investigate cache heuristics canary.

tony: thanks. taking over. I'll keep watches for 1h and coordinate with infra if we see regression. please attach perf graphs to the incident ticket and add contact list.

meera: adding note: we should schedule a postmortem to look at smart-routing weight defaults and build a safer canary rollback trigger (cache-miss amplification).

carlo: agree. also recommend auto-apply partial steering earlier when p95 delta exceeds threshold for 3m.

tony: logging that. closing mitigation loop now but will keep thread pinned for updates.

incident-bot: INCIDENT ACKNOWLEDGED -> mitigating. status: MONITORING. assigned: tony.

maya: leaving channel, thanks all. :wave:

tony: will update if anything changes.

meera: follow-up owner for PM/engineering action: carlo.

carlo: ack.
